description:
Choose what is tracked in AI answers.
action:
- track(prompts): Track up to 25 prompts at once: each comes back added or skipped with why (the plan's limit, a repeat). intent: informational, commercial or transactional. One naming the brand stays out of the headline rate.
- retire(promptId): Stop tracking one. Its history stays.
- restore(promptId): Track a retired prompt again, with its history, while there's room.
- models(models): The tracked AI models: exactly the plan's count.
name: update_prompts
title: Change tracked prompts
